data.name: BND-Legenden: Operation Blackbox
data.detailed_description:
BND Legends: Operation Blackbox is a story-driven stealth and infiltration game that places you in the role of AJ, a field agent of the German Federal Intelligence Service. Your mission leads you deep into the high-security headquarters of Warlink.AI, a foreign tech corporation suspected of developing a devastating AI-powered cyber weapon known as T-Cell. Hidden somewhere inside the facility lies the Blackbox, a sealed server containing all research data. Your task is to infiltrate the complex, retrieve as much information as possible, and escape before the enemy security forces can react.

Your Team

AJ never enters the mission alone. She is supported remotely by two specialists who help shape every decision inside the field.
Atlas, the team’s geo-intelligence and tactics expert, scans the environment, reveals camera sightlines and patrol zones, and provides strategic guidance that helps you navigate the facility unseen. Ruby, the team’s hacker, accesses locked systems, manipulates devices, overrides defenses, and leads you through intricate hacking challenges that reach far into enemy networks. Together, the three agents form a tightly coordinated unit whose collaboration is crucial for the success of Operation Blackbox.

The Setting: Warlink.AI Headquarters

The entire operation takes place in the tech district of Te-Guug, the futuristic capital of Bethulan. Warlink.AI’s headquarters resembles a fortified research citadel made of steel, carbon and glass, guarded by drones, soldiers and cutting-edge surveillance technology. More than a simple office building, this sprawling facility houses experimental AI labs, production halls and deep server layers. Somewhere within this fortress lies the guarded Blackbox – your primary objective and the key to uncovering the T-Cell threat.

Gameplay and Mission

Your journey spans five atmospheric levels, each offering its own tone and set of challenges. The outer premises serve as a warm-up in which AJ learns to move silently and stay in the shadows. From there, you infiltrate the heavily monitored entrance complex, where disguises, misdirection and careful observation are the only ways to advance without raising suspicion.
The mission then leads you into a pitch-dark production hall, a maze filled with patrolling drones, industrial noise and a massive ceiling crane that you must carefully maneuver through a dangerous obstacle course while trying to restore the power supply.

Pressure intensifies as you reach the Quantum Layer, a high-tech server zone filled with patrols, platform puzzles and a temporary identity cloak that can collapse at the worst possible moment. After a security alert, every second counts while you fight your way toward the data vault before the entire area locks down.
The operation culminates inside a virtual data stream, where Ruby dives into a surreal digital environment, races through endless data corridors, evades firewalls and defensive protocols, and extracts the final pieces of intelligence needed to expose the full scope of the T-Cell weapon.

Atmosphere and Tension

BND Legends: Operation Blackbox blends stealth, strategy, dynamic environmental challenges and cinematic storytelling into a concentrated, high-tension experience. The world of Bethulan, infused with high-tech espionage, political intrigue and the looming threat of an AI catastrophe, creates a gripping backdrop for AJ’s mission. Working together with Atlas and Ruby, you must stay silent, stay hidden and stay in control. Every step in the shadows brings you closer to the Blackbox – or straight into danger.

data.short_description: BND Legends: Operation Blackbox is a tactical stealth adventure where you guide agent AJ through a fortified tech compound, infiltrate enemy systems, steal critical data, and complete clever minigames with support from your elite BND team.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Win 10
  • Processor: Intel i5 or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce RTX 2070 oder ähnlich
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Win 11
  • Processor: Intel i5 or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce RTX 3070 or similar
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
